hero.headline: A Clear Path to Liquidity
hero.subheadline: We build infrastructure assets with an institutional exit in mind, targeting global tech buyers and infrastructure funds within a 5-7 year horizon.

sections.title: Monetizing the Infrastructure Backbone
sections.body: Kenya AI Compute is designed to be a highly attractive target for institutional acquisition. As the global AI market matures, the value of 'distressed' or 'unoptimized' grid-connected data centers will fall, while the premium for facilities with locked-in, low-cost captive power—like ours—будет grow exponentially. Our exit strategy is focused on a 5-to-7 year window, by which time Phase 2 (1MW) and Phase 3 (3MW+) will be fully operational and delivering consistent cash flows. Potential exit routes include a strategic sale to global hyperscalers (AWS, Google, Microsoft) looking to expand their African footprint, acquisition by a dedicated infrastructure fund, or a public listing on an international exchange. sections.title: Strategic Exit Routes
items: Strategic Sale: Acquisition by global cloud providers seeking to secure low-cost compute nodes.
Infrastructure Consolidation: Sale to major data center REITs (Equinix, Digital Realty) entering the region.
Dividend Recapitalization: Providing early liquidity through senior debt while retaining equity ownership.
Secondary Market: Facilitating share transfers between institutional investors as the project matures.
Public Listing: A long-term path toward a regional or international tech IPO.
